description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that acts as the main entry point for an Android app featuring drag-and-drop functionality. It manages UI fragments, menu options, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends SampleActivityBase, serving as the launcher activity that initializes UI fragments and manages logging in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads layout, and sets up default fragment if starting fresh.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu items' visibility and titles based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log visibility.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up custom logging chain, including log filtering and on-screen display.
